articles.title: Marvel's X-Men Just Got a Whole Lot Bigger (and Weirder)!
articles.summary: Marvel finally revealed the new X-Men cast! Adam Driver will play the villain Mr. Sinister, and Sadie Sink is Jean Grey. The movie comes out May 5, 2028.

articles.title: Disney Princesses Unite for a Magical Concert — and You Can Watch Free!
articles.summary: The original voices of Ariel, Belle, Moana, and Jasmine sang together at Disneyland for a TV special. It airs Sunday at 8 p.m. on ABC and Disney+.

articles.title: Tako the Piano-Playing Octopus Hangs Up His Tentacles
articles.summary: Tako, an octopus who learned to play piano by pulling keys, has retired. His owner says Tako is getting old and wants him to rest peacefully.
